$comment: Which published packages run code in Node, so their unit tests also run on Node 22.12 and the latest 22.x (scripts/node22-tests.mjs, CI job 'node22 unit tests (Node-run packages)'). Every published package (packages/*, tools/*) is in exactly one list; a package with a bin, a node export condition or a node:* import in src must be in node or contributorNode (tests/node22-packages.test.js). Browser-only packages are covered on Node 22 by the end-user proof (CI node-compat: every entry imports, the packed consumer run, the bundler matrix). tests: extra test files outside the package's own tests/ and test/ folders.

node.@margoengine/mcp: bin margoengine-mcp: an MCP server over stdio (node:fs, node:child_process, node:readline)
node.@margoengine/netcode: @margoengine/netcode/node: the WebSocket game server on node:http
node.@margoengine/net: imported by the netcode and voxel-net servers
node.@margoengine/voxel-net: @margoengine/voxel-net/server: the voxel world server on node:http and worker_threads
node.@margoengine/voxel: world state, codec, query and generation run inside voxel-net's server
node.@margoengine/voxel-edit: reads and writes MagicaVoxel .vox files and sparse edits with no GPU, used by tools
node.@margoengine/save: the Node file adapter (node:fs/promises) and the save codec
node.@margoengine/biomes: biome maps, climate fields and classification run on the CPU with no browser API; their digests are checked in Node

margo-convert.reason: bin margo-convert: the offline asset pipeline

node.@margoengine/exporters: margo-convert's export path (glTF, USDZ, game engine formats) runs in Node
node.@margoengine/decoders: margo-convert decodes PNG and meshopt in Node
node.@margoengine/gltf-pro: imported by exporters; its loaders parse server-side
node.@margoengine/loaders: format parsers documented as SSR safe (STL, OBJ, PLY, 3MF, DXF, DAE and more)
node.@margoengine/points: LAS, LAZ, E57 and octree parsers
node.@margoengine/tiles: 3D Tiles tileset parsing and traversal with no GPU
node.@margoengine/webgl2-compat: the WGSL front end (lexer, parser, type checker), tooling that runs in Node
node.@margoengine/shader: shader composition and validation, tooling that runs in Node
node.@margoengine/compute: the CPU backend runs in Node
node.@margoengine/bvh: BVH build and queries with no GPU (raycasts on a server)
node.@margoengine/cache: the asset cache with no GPU
node.@margoengine/behavior: behavior trees and steering with no GPU or DOM: game server logic
node.@margoengine/ecs: entity component system with no GPU or DOM: game server logic
node.@margoengine/fsm: state machines with no GPU or DOM: game server logic
node.@margoengine/navmesh: navigation meshes and path finding with no GPU or DOM: game server logic
node.@margoengine/wfc: wave function collapse generation with no GPU or DOM
node.@margoengine/procedural: procedural generation with no GPU or DOM
node.@margoengine/geometry: geometry generation with no GPU or DOM
node.@margoengine/mesh-edit: mesh editing with no GPU or DOM
node.@margoengine/physics: physics with no GPU or DOM: game server simulation
node.@margoengine/physics2d: 2D physics with no GPU or DOM: game server simulation
node.@margoengine/ragdoll: ragdoll physics with no GPU or DOM: game server simulation of limp bodies
node.@margoengine/splines: splines with no GPU or DOM
node.@margoengine/tween: tweens with no GPU or DOM
node.@margoengine/cameras: camera rigs as maths with no GPU or DOM
node.@margoengine/cinematic: cinematic sequencing with no GPU or DOM
node.@margoengine/kinematics-constraints: kinematics with no GPU or DOM
node.@margoengine/rigging: rigging with no GPU or DOM
node.@margoengine/road: road generation with no GPU or DOM
node.@margoengine/tilemap: tile map data helpers with no GPU or DOM
node.@margoengine/mixer: the animation mixer with no GPU or DOM
node.@margoengine/lightmap: lightmap baking with no GPU or DOM

@margoengine/animator.reason: blend trees, IK and constraints with no GPU or DOM; its tests live in the root tests folder

@margoengine/gltf.reason: margo-convert parses glTF with it in Node; its own tests are a section of tests/modern.test.js (core, run on 24), so the margo-convert tests cover its Node path here

contributorNode.@margoengine/react: its unit tests rely on node:test mock.module timing that Node 22 does not give (bug 18), so they run on the contributors' Node 24.18; React 18 SSR itself runs on Node 22 in the end-user proof
